description: PM-2b: a plan's reserves, embarkations and leader attachments drive the AI's FORMATIONS declarations. The predeploy fixtures start at DEPLOYMENT with formations already confirmed, so this scenario starts on the main menu and bootstraps a real menu-style game (recon_stomps mirror on hammer_anvil, both seats AI) the way MainMenu._initialize_game_with_config does, then hands both seats the same plan AFTER AIPlayer.configure (which clears plans). It asserts that when FORMATIONS confirms, meta.formations records exactly the plan's declarations on BOTH seats - including player 2, whose units carry the _P2 mirror re-key - and that the AI's decision records attribute them to the plan.

steps.script:
var config = {
	"terrain": "take_and_hold_vs_purge_the_foe_3",
	"mission": "take_and_hold",
	"deployment": "hammer_anvil",
	"player1_army": "recon_stomps",
	"player2_army": "recon_stomps",
	"player1_type": "HUMAN",
	"player2_type": "HUMAN",
	"player1_difficulty": 1,
	"player2_difficulty": 1,
	"ai_speed": 0,
	"player1_secondary_mode": "tactical",
	"player2_secondary_mode": "tactical",
	"player1_fixed_missions": [],
	"player2_fixed_missions": [],
	"player1_disposition": "",
	"player2_disposition": "",
	"player1_name": "",
	"player2_name": "",
}
# Mirrors MainMenu._initialize_game_with_config (MainMenu.gd:1499-1591).
GameState.state.clear()
GameState.initialize_default_state(config.deployment)
GameState.state.meta["game_config"] = config
TerrainManager.current_layout = config.terrain
TerrainManager.load_terrain_layout(config.terrain)
BoardState.initialize_deployment_zones(config.deployment)
MissionManager.initialize_mission(config.mission)
GameState.state.units.clear()
for player in [1, 2]:
	var army = ArmyListManager.load_army_for_game(config["player%d_army" % player], player)
	if army.is_empty():
		return "ARMY_LOAD_FAILED"
	ArmyListManager.apply_army_to_game_state(army, player)
SecondaryMissionManager.initialize_for_game()
GameState.state.meta["game_config"] = config
GameState.state.meta["from_menu"] = true
RulesEngine.set_test_seed(7101)
SecondaryMissionManager.set_test_seed(7101)
AIDecisionMaker.set_ai_seed(7101)
return "units=%d" % GameState.state.units.size()

var plan = PlanValidator.load_plan_file("res://tests/fixtures/ai_plans/fixture_recon_stomps_rich.json")
if plan.is_empty():
	return "NO_PLAN"
# configure() clears plans, so it has to come first.
# Engine human-gates read game_config.playerN_type and default to
# HUMAN, so flip them to AI now that the scene is up.
var gc = GameState.state["meta"]["game_config"]
gc["player1_type"] = "AI"
gc["player2_type"] = "AI"
GameState.state["meta"]["game_config"] = gc
AIPlayer.configure({1: "AI", 2: "AI"}, {1: 1, 2: 1})
AIPlayer.set_ai_speed_preset(0)
AIDecisionMaker.set_player_plan(1, plan)
AIDecisionMaker.set_player_plan(2, plan)
return str(plan.get("name", ""))
steps.equals: Fixture — Recon Stomps rich (all five verbs)
